skill.displayName: ClawKeeper — Tasks & habits in a plain markdown file

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions match its stated purpose (a local CLI-backed task/habit manager); only minor bookkeeping issues (npm install risk and a mis-labelled environment variable) were found.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (task & habit management) align with required binary (clawkeeper) and the CLAWKEEPER_DIR path where markdown data is stored. No unrelated credentials, binaries, or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md limits the agent to running the clawkeeper CLI against files in CLAWKEEPER_DIR and to occasional 'heartbeat' checks. It does not instruct reading unrelated system files or exfiltrating data to external endpoints. It does assume the agent can read/write the specified directory (expected for this kind of tool).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is via an npm package named 'clawkeeper' which is a reasonable distribution channel for a CLI that provides a 'clawkeeper' binary. Note that npm installs can execute package install scripts and will write files/binaries to disk — review the package source before installing if you need stronger assurance.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only CLAWKEEPER_DIR is required, which is appropriate for a file-backed task manager. However 'primaryEnv' is set to CLAWKEEPER_DIR (a filesystem path) — calling a path the primary credential is a mild metadata mismatch but not a functional problem. No secrets or unrelated tokens are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-loaded and is user-invocable. disable-model-invocation is false (normal), so the agent could invoke the skill autonomously when allowed — this is expected behavior and not excessive by itself.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for managing tasks stored as markdown in a local directory. Before installing: (1) Confirm you trust the npm package 'clawkeeper' — inspect its npm page and repository if available, because npm installs can run scripts. (2) Set CLAWKEEPER_DIR to a directory you control and that does not contain secrets, since the CLI will read/write files there. (3) If you do not want the agent to run this autonomously, disable model invocation for this skill or only invoke it manually. If you need higher assurance, run the npm install in a sandbox or review the package source code first.
llm.findings: [no_scan_findings] expected: The package is instruction-only (no code files shipped in the skill bundle), so the regex-based scanner had nothing to analyze. This is expected; the runtime behavior depends on the external 'clawkeeper' binary/npm package.
